gaps.lead: 'I broke the window,' the boy said.
gaps.sentence: When caught, the boy ___ the window.
gaps.explanation: admit + -ing, or admit having + past participle for the earlier action.

gaps.lead: My salary is half the size of my brother's.
gaps.explanation: 'Half the size of' reversed becomes 'twice as much as'.

gaps.lead: Selling the boat was a big mistake.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle expresses regret about a past action.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Couldn't go because of' → 'were prevented from going'.

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action continuing from a past point to now: has been working (present perfect continuous).
